NOTICE OF BOOK CLOSURE FOR PROFIT
MCB Bank Limited
PAYMENT/REDEMPTIONOF9THINSTALLMENT
OF MCBTFC2 ISSUE DATED JUNE 19, 2014
Ninth profit  payment /  redemption  of Term
Finance Certificates ("TFCs") issue of MCB Bank
Limited -TFC dated June 19, 2014 ("MCBTFC2")
are due on December 19, 2018. The transfer
books pertaining to this issue shall remain closed
from December 12, 2018 to December 19, 2018
(both days inclusive). Requests for transfers
received by the Bank's Transfer Agent, M/s. THK
Associates (Pvt.) Limited at 1st Floor, 40-C,
Block-6, PECHS, Karachi, Tel: (+9221)111-000-322
by the close of business on December 11, 2018
will be treated as in time for the purpose of the
subject entitlement.
TFC holders are requested to intimate change of
address, if any, to the Bank's Transfer Agent
immediately.
FidaAliMirza
